description: Hey, I'm a music producer and artist. I create music for various media, including games, films, commercials, VTubers, and more. If you're interested in commissioning a piece or have any questions, feel free to reach out to me.

packages.title: Full Original Song Production
packages.shortDesc: Completely custom original song from scratch in your desired style/genre.
includes: ~2–4 minute long original song in your requested style/genre
WAV + MP3 (and any other format you need)
addons: Extra length: +$120 per additional 30 seconds past 4 min
Commercial/streaming upload rights: contact to discuss (see ToS §5)

packages.title: Loopable BGM / Background Music
packages.shortDesc: Seamless, loopable ambient or thematic background music for streams, games or videos.

packages.title: Vocal Mix & Master
packages.shortDesc: Professional cleaning, tuning, mixing and mastering of your vocal recordings.
includes: Noise removal, de-essing, tuning & timing correction
Balanced mix with your provided instrumental
addons: Additional vocal layers / harmonies: +$25 per track

tos.title: PAYMENT
tos.content: A 50% non-refundable deposit is required to start work. The remaining 50% is due upon completion and before final files are delivered.

tos.title: REVISIONS
tos.content: Packages include the stated number of revisions. Additional revisions are charged at $25–40 per round depending on complexity.

tos.title: COMMERCIAL / STREAMING RIGHTS
tos.content: Personal use is included. Monetized content, YouTube, Spotify, etc. requires an additional license fee — please discuss before ordering.

tos.title: PORTFOLIO RIGHTS
tos.content: I retain the right to use the work in my portfolio / social media / showreel unless you explicitly request otherwise (extra fee may apply).

tos.title: COMMUNICATION & INACTIVITY
tos.content: Please stay responsive. Projects inactive for more than 30 days without communication may be cancelled without refund of deposit.

tos.title: CANCELLATION
tos.content: If you cancel after work has started, the deposit is non-refundable. Mid-project cancellation may require payment for work completed.

tos.title: DELIVERY FORMAT
tos.content: Standard delivery is WAV (48 kHz / 24-bit) + MP3. Other formats available on request.
